items.title: Perez carries a five-place grid penalty to Lusail
items.summary: Formula1.com reports Perez will take a five-place grid penalty in Qatar for the Turn 14 collision with Rafael Camara in Las Vegas.
items.why_it_matters: It affects the Cadillac's qualifying-to-race plan; confirm the final grid after Saturday.

items.title: Qatar follows a Las Vegas race of Ferrari, Mercedes and Red Bull storylines
items.summary: Verstappen won in Las Vegas ahead of Norris and Piastri, Mercedes lost podium positions late, and Ferrari's drivers collided again.
items.why_it_matters: These are the open questions entering Lusail; Qatar practice has not run, so there is no on-track Qatar evidence yet.
